changes: Adapted registration and item containers to the host addon.
Added English/Chinese decorative names and short decorative tooltips.
Exposed legacy cores and fuel/turbine appearances as decorative metadata variants.
Preserved source metadata holes, face textures, translucent glass and visual light levels.
Omitted upstream recipes, inventories, machines, heating-coil and glass-tier capabilities.

Reused native GregTech IBlockWithTextures rendering; decorative panels have no tile entity or machine behavior. Native inventory backgrounds remain runtime references; derived GT connected backgrounds are separately licensed.

Only Eddington metadata conducts native GregTech machine updates; Vault ports unbind when their structure becomes invalid.

Added a host-specific MV assembler recipe for two Eddington Wall Casings: six steel plates, one steel frame, four copper foils, circuit 24, 144 mB molten tin, base duration 10 seconds at 120 EU/t.

referencePackaging: The sibling source directory, extracted dependency sources and ignored build/stellar-block-reference, build/eddington-ctm-reference and build/stellar-ctm-reference previews are not source/resource inputs.

runtimeUse.panelBaseTextures: Unjoined inventory backgrounds reference installed GT5-Unofficial 5.09.54.183 casing textures; five derived native GT connected bases are separately licensed and mapped in META-INF/stellar-panel-ctm/ASSET_MANIFEST.json. Extraction uses the local MIT casing.

connectedTextures.implementation: Built-in StellarConnections, StellarConnectedIcons and StellarConnectedTexture with native block icons and GT copied-block rendering; no MyCTMLib, CTMUtils, resource-pack rules or additional dependencies.
connectedTextures.algorithm: Preserve the central artwork pixel-for-pixel and only replace each connected outer frame. Core textures use a safe background pixel, band and rail textures extend corresponding source rows/columns, and 1 px glass frames use the existing alpha-110 glass color. Rail samples skip edge rivets; unframed rails and directional fins preserve their original exposed ends. Other exposed frames continue through perpendicular joins, and missing diagonals restore native concave corner caps. Mask 0 is a byte-identical original. No rotation, interpolation, rescaling or new colors.
connectedTextures.visibility: Only coplanar exposed faces join; diagonals require both cardinal neighbours. Opaque or side-solid face-normal covers exclude hidden faces. Same-material glass in the face-normal direction excludes hidden glass faces; different glass metadata retains its shared boundary.
connectedTextures.inventory: Original standalone block icons and runtime native GT inventory casing textures.
connectedTextures.overlays: All original controller/panel/port front graphics, animation metadata and glow remain separate.
connectedTextures.eddingtonAlgorithm: Keep the original metal interior and exposed 2 px frame; replace joined frame bands with nearest interior metal pixels; extend the orange grille across horizontal joins; continue exposed frames across perpendicular joins; restore native 2x2 corner patches for absent diagonals. Mask 0 is a byte-identical source copy. No interpolation, rescaling or new colors.
connectedTextures.connectionIdentity: The current face texture key, not the registry metadata or front overlay. Empty/fueled pillars share end textures but not side textures; panels sharing a base join across overlays; Extraction panels join the matching local casing. Native GT casing blocks retain their renderer and do not participate.
connectedTextures.generatorSha256Scope: Original Eddington generator; the generators array records both exact generator hashes.
